notes.title: UPDATE EA v0.02 (THOUSANDS OF SPECTATORS WILL FOLLOW YOUR RACKET'S EVERY MOVE)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004865/b7f1937bd1e49fe0a5719ebbaa52612f2122f4a3.jpg[/img]

[b][u]UPDATE EARLY ACCESS v0.02[/u][/b]

IMPROVEMENTS:

There is now a new environment with stands in the 1_player and 2_players scenes.

Tens of thousands of spectators have been added, who have their own animation, and applaud when players score a goal.

The sounds of the applause has been changed to match the thousands of new spectators.

Modified the final scoring scenes in both 1_player and 2_players modes to fit the new environment.

Added functionality for computer screens wider than 16/9 aspect ratio, for this, the opening menu scenes, and the final point awarding scenes in 1_player and 2_players mode are also adjusted.


BUG FIXES:

Fixes for menu > 1_Player > Easy_button & Hard_button misalignments that occurred with some screen resolutions in some languages.

Fix Brazilian Portuguese Language > 1_player - 2_player > End_of_Game_Menu > Final text messages in wrong language.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE v0.01 TO IMPROVE LEADERBOARDS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004865/3b8c7204f6f435c05eac68032b4ebb21f89fb69e.jpg[/img]

[b][u]TENNISTRONIC'S FIRST UPDATE IN EARLY ACCESS v0.01[/u][/b]

The purpose of this update is to make the Leaderboards fully functional. For the moment they are available on the Steam website and in the Steam API (by pressing Shift+Tab during the game > Achievements > Leaderboards > Global Leaderboards).

Once the update is downloaded, when you finish playing the first game in single-player mode, any record you have previously stored will be saved on the leaderboards. And from that moment on, all the scores you get will be saved directly on the leaderboards. Remember that for this, it is essential to be logged in Steam and be connected to the internet when you play the game.

As you already know, Steam leaderboards allow you to see the world score records, and also the score records of your friends who have the game.
